name: collapsible_row_scroll
description: CollapsibleRow container combined with horizontalScroll modifier

parameters.suspicious_reason: Horizontal mirror of collapsible_column_scroll: the collapse is decided against the viewport, but RowLayout positions the survivors against the pre-collapse virtual scroll dimension (RowLayout.java:336-347, 472-474), leaving a (240-160)/2 = 40px offset the collapse never reclaims. Separately, the collapsed child is recorded at x=40, the same position as the first surviving child, because RowLayout.java:546-550 assigns x before the isGone check. That is a shared coordinate, not a painted overlap: the child is GONE and is never drawn.
